reasons.persona_fit: Directly addresses small-business owners in a calm, practical tone without hype or sales pressure, though it slips into 'I' once instead of standard public 'we'.
reasons.clarity: Logical, crisp structure distinguishing concrete workflows from vague outcomes, with clear formatting and plain English throughout.
reasons.actionability: Provides a practical 4-part bounding checklist and diagnostic screening questions that an owner can immediately apply before adopting AI.
reasons.factual_grounding: Contains no invented customers, metrics, or capability claims; stays fully within approved guidelines.
